slice: Woodshed canonical bar clocks with legacy take preservation
ruling: Preserve original playback clocks and PCM for existing takes; canonical rule for new captures.

clock_policy.new: audio_primitives::frames_per_bar: quarter-note BPM, denominator honoured, round per beat before multiplying measures
clock_policy.legacy: Original whole-block f32 rounding, truncated beats, original count-in and chord-envelope operation order
clock_policy.wire: V3 manifests use clock=per-beat-v1 for new takes. Missing clock remains legacy. Unchanged old-only catalogs retain V1/V2 as appropriate.
clock_policy.recording: Explicit Clear required for loaded legacy segments before a new take; refusal occurs before input opens.
clock_policy.clear: Removes reference/runtime PCM by explicit owner action and returns the segment to canonical clock; no implicit trimming/padding/resampling.

commands: cargo test --locked --offline -p woodshed-audio -p woodshed-core -p woodshed-genet -p woodshed-views
checks.counting: Suite totals only; fresh-process child executions and repeated suites are not added again. Gold is one separately invoked ignored probe.

qualification: Fractional and eighth-meter count-in, exact per-frame capture at the existing next-bar-wrap Arm schedule, and no allocations/deallocations in guarded processor renders.
48 kHz heterogeneous multi-measure WAV/live float-bit parity over varying processing block sizes.
Sealed mixed-clock restore: 253744-frame legacy take plus 105110-frame canonical take; original reference and encrypted companion unchanged; decoded float bits exact after reopen.
Fresh-process sealed filesystem V1 migration/reorder/clear/reopen sequence passed.
Capture clock missing-field roundtrip, V3 admission, preserved unknown clock string with explicit refusal, owner identity and legacy input guard.
Metronome denominator timing uses integer frame numerators without per-frame fractional drift and preserves phase across tempo edits.

accepted_gold.fixture: Read-only original domain snapshot and deterministic quiet PCM fixture, validated against its original raw content-address before rendering. No Keeper or original encrypted profile is opened for this reconstruction.

original_fixture_retention.note: Session/settings already differed from the early profile-before receipt at task start; all four files stayed identical to this task start. Both original companion hashes still match the historical receipt.

scope_limits: Set capture metadata still uses quarter-note meter. x/8 qualification is at the audio/runtime/export layer, not a new saved-product meter editor.
No foreground native, microphone, acoustic, latency, or physical-device qualification claimed.
Ringdown file clock convention and Hocket capture scheduling unchanged.
Shared frame-driven DSP extraction remains the next slice.
